scope: Implementation of all 18 reviewed gaps, preserving native feature access

findings.title: Missing settings caused by stale option bindings
findings.change: Current VLC bindings for resume, notifications and geometry, plus notification duration.

findings.title: Toolbar bookmark button can be disabled for a newly opened file
findings.change: Bookmark button works for an unindexed file at a valid timestamp.

findings.title: Settings organization is only partly reworked
findings.change: All native preferences regrouped across the 13 categories; Advanced Options and search retain every native key.

findings.title: Friendly setting controls are missing
findings.change: Percentage/time/speed sliders, relative or pixel font size, meaningful buffers and audio effect switches.

findings.title: Subtitle filename matching is still a number
Bookmark timestamps omit the displayed milliseconds
findings.change: Bookmark display includes HH:MM:SS.mmm; native rename, seek, remove and storage retained.

findings.title: Shortcut feedback does not include the pressed key
findings.change: Native OSD preserves the action/value and appends the actual shortcut once; key display and duration are configurable.

findings.title: Extensions still open the mixed native manager
findings.change: Installed add-ons, catalog search, install/remove and package import are in Settings; original native tools remain in Advanced.

findings.title: Separate redesigned stream and media dialogs are missing
findings.change: Separate file, network, disc, capture, convert and stream entry panels; multiline URLs and optional named native playlists; original advanced wizard remains.

findings.title: Current-folder browsing and queue cannot stay open together
findings.change: Current-folder browsing, breadcrumbs, media selection/drag and queue insertion coexist with the right native queue.

findings.title: Subtitle timeline is a list rather than draggable seek-bar cues
findings.change: Real text cues appear above the seek bar; click seeks and horizontal drag adjusts the native delay, with cancel support.

findings.title: Saved live presets do not capture every displayed setting
findings.change: Live presets include all displayed options, secondary delay, FPS, native framing/deinterlace and audio device/track choices.

findings.title: Friendly filter presets and visual previews are absent
findings.change: Named equalizer and picture cards with visual icons apply actual VLC filters immediately.

findings.title: Quick audio-output selection is absent from the new Audio tab
findings.change: Quick Audio device choices use the native enumerator and selector; absent saved devices retain the current output.

findings.title: Playback display switches are incomplete
findings.change: Waveform, metadata, thumbnail and cue visibility are working native settings.

findings.title: Controls use a timer rather than the proposed edge-hover behavior
findings.change: Edge hover shows controls; leaving hides them. Locks, keyboard access, fullscreen policy and pinned controls remain.

findings.title: Reverse playback needs codec-specific verification
findings.change: Native reverse remains where supported. Seekable files otherwise have a discrete reverse video preview with audio paused; tested time decreases and new frames decode.

findings.title: Picture-in-picture currently means the embedded library mini-player
findings.change: Floating mode uses the existing native window, stays on top and restores geometry/modes. The separate embedded library mini-player remains available.

limitations: Reverse fallback is discrete video seeking with audio paused; every codec not certified
Popout transforms the existing native VLC window; embedded library mini-player remains separate
Device, optical disc, remote protocol, casting and real subtitle-provider account workflows not all exercised
Private review build; exact dependency-source and specific design-licence evidence still required for public binary distribution
